name: The Void Trackers

identity.symbol: A broken eye with a star pupil

headquarters.description: A converted basement accessed through a collapsed storm drain

leadership.appearance: Never seen personally, communicates only through mirrors

membership.initiation: Stare into a Void-spark for 3 days without going mad

goals: Track and contain Void rifts before they spread
Prevent the Unseen from opening major rifts

enemies.reason: They want rifts, Trackers seal them

加入条件.approach: Find one of their mirrors in the Underworks and ask a question
加入条件.trial: They will test you with Void-exposure

quest_hooks.name: Trial of Mirrors
quest_hooks.description: Pass the Trackers' test to prove you can survive near the Void

quest_hooks.name: Contain the Rift
quest_hooks.description: Assist in sealing a newly-discovered Void rift

quest_hooks.name: Find The Reader
quest_hooks.description: Locate the leadership of the Void Trackers

recruitment_rumor: They say if you stare into a mirror in the Underworks at midnight and ask 'Who watches?', someone might answer.
